title: OldDonutsmpscoreboard
description: OG Donutsmp Scoreboard. Feel like your in 2020 again!
body:
Brings the iconic DonutSMP sidebar to any world — gradient titles, live stats, and that classic server feel, all client-side.
Fake it 'til you make it. A fully client-side DonutSMP-style scoreboard with kills, deaths, playtime, and a gradient blue title. No server required.
That nostalgic DonutSMP sidebar you miss — now on any server. Gradient title, fake stats, playtime tracker, and the signature server IP footer.
